acceptance_signals: The first execution action after separate human take-up captures this exact task-start baseline before any repository or temporary-fixture write.
Final comparison has zero failures; current task deltas stay in scope; excluded dirty paths and the seven classification-only predecessor task records remain byte-identical.
One system-temporary synthetic repository contains only non-sensitive content, zero remotes, and exactly one permitted local baseline commit before the Agent turn.
Current source is binary-safely allowlisted into temporary staging, built once into a digest-identified wheel without Starter mutation, and installed in a fresh Python 3.11 runtime.
No-model gates verify artifact and CLI identity, fixture state, user configuration and trust digests, ambient process baseline, required MCP startup, and expected tool inventory.
Exactly one ordinary low-risk request starts one external Codex turn without AgentGov names, protocol JSON, coaching, retry, or a second session.
Evidence distinguishes proposal, human decision, take-up, implementation, validation, native completion when callable, self-review, completion card, handoff, terminal state, and first deviation.
Any failed gate, unusable human form, unexpected persistence, scope drift, host or MCP error, mutation, or stalled state stops without repair, restart, substitution, or second turn.
Retained evidence excludes raw request, response, transcript, source, patch, validation output, credentials, absolute paths, external session IDs, process IDs, and private reasoning.
Post-state proves measured user state unchanged, no task process remains, fixture has no remote or extra commit, and exact task-owned temporary assets are removed.
Experiment record, STATUS, dated log, and documentation tests agree on outcome, interactions, limits, and denied authority.
Focused and full tests, governance checks, task JSON, scope comparison, privacy scan, and git diff check pass.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-de669814cffd463286b413e50387545f and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Run one bounded exact-artifact automatic-governance rehearsal in a new system-temporary, remote-free synthetic non-NYC repository with one permitted local baseline commit. Build the exact current AgentGov source from an allowlisted temporary staging copy, install it in a fresh Python 3.11 runtime, pass no-model host and MCP gates, then start exactly one ordinary low-risk external Codex turn without governance coaching, internal JSON, repeated next queries, manually composed lifecycle commands, or special confirmation words. Observe proposal review, human admission if reached, separate task take-up, the bounded edit, declared validation, native completion when callable, current-Agent review, completion card, handoff, and first deviation. Stop without repair or retry, retain only sanitized evidence, remove task-owned temporary assets, preserve user configuration and trust state, and make no Starter source fix or external Git, publication, release, deployment, or NYC change.

items: The single external turn uses the existing authenticated Codex entitlement and may fail or consume usage before completion.
Dirty-source staging could include unrelated material unless the binary-safe package allowlist and digest gates pass.
A fixture or host binding could target Starter, an existing consumer, or user state unless resolved path and digest gates pass.
The local baseline commit is permitted only inside the verified remote-free fixture and grants no Starter or consumer Git authority.
Native form mediation may be unavailable or require one visible human decision; the run must count it and never bypass it.
Host, protocol, Adapter, or completion-tool surfaces may differ and must fail closed.
Cleanup is destructive only for exact verified task-owned system-temporary paths after evidence is retained.
One synthetic run cannot prove adoption, reliability, causal benefit, time savings, ROI, production readiness, or repeatability.
Reviewed assumption: Python 3.11, local build tooling, Git, Codex, and an authenticated Codex entitlement are available.
Reviewed assumption: Current source can be staged and built without downloading a dependency.
Reviewed assumption: A synthetic README-only task can be implemented and validated without downloads.
Reviewed assumption: Existing controller, process observer, and MCP Adapter can be used without source changes.
Reviewed assumption: The product owner can answer one native task-admission form if reached.
Reviewed assumption: Starter HEAD and every excluded dirty path remain unchanged.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the exact current source builds and installs from the allowlisted staging copy.

Reviewed unknown: Whether native form elicitation is available and bound in the external session.
Reviewed unknown: Whether take-up, completion recording, review, completion card, and handoff all occur.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the host writes state outside measured configuration, trust, process, and temporary boundaries.
Reviewed unknown: Whether one synthetic run is representative of a real consumer.
